kept.spine: The rules in this town have rooms a traveller can find, the hall and the courthouse and the customs house.
People can afford to argue about something other than money.
No one has to explain why a town stands on this ground.
The walls are sound and the watch walks its circuit, and neither of them is for show.
Against the beasts of this ground the town has men who know the work and the tools the work takes.
Order holds on the main streets and thins in the lanes behind them.
Spitzplatz is a town in the plain meaning of the word.
